findings.message: 4 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Repair, without the runaround." → 3 lines (4 words, 129.6px); "Your home gets quiet again" → 3 lines (5 words, 43.2px); "Small details. Less disruption." → 4 lines (4 words, 80.6px); "Let’s get the right person on it." → 3 lines (7 words, 72px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 10 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Appliance repair / Chicago, IL" above "Repair, without the runaround."; "Choose an appliance" above "Start with what you can see."; "03" above "Your home gets quiet again"; "01" above "You name the problem"; "02" above "A master calls you"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "SM", "APPLIANCE REPAIR", "Appliance repair / Chicago, IL", "PARTS READY"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 15 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Appliance repair / Chicago, IL", "PARTS READY", "ASSEMBLY COMPLETE / READY", "We work across").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 5 gradient fill(s): div.machine-glow → radial-gradient(circle, color(srgb 1 0.415686 0.168627 / 0.18), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 68%) | div.washer → linear-gradient(120deg, rgb(227, 228, 230), rgb(140, 144, 151)) | span → radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%, rgb(82, 98, 108), rgb(22, 26, 34) 64%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.washer → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) 8px 0px 22px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 20px 35px 5
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 26 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.site-header 1440px | section.brand-strip 1440px | div.selector-list 746px | button.appliance-row 746px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 2 box(es) drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Prefer a filled surface or no box.

findings.message: 8 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "AFTER" 2.4:1 (#8b91a0 on #dfe3e1)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Inter, Inter Tight, JetBrains Mono).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.2:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 28 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 294px at 1440px. Widest offenders: strong (+294px), span (+294px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "Repair, without the runaround." → 3 lines (4 words, 69.1px); "Your home gets quiet again" → 3 lines (5 words, 28px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 428px of the width empty: "From broken to working.".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Repair, without the runaround." → 4 lines (4 words, 66.3px); "Your home gets quiet again" → 3 lines (5 words, 28px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 10 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 16px from the left edge but only to 54px from the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "customer rating" (0px from the right); "average callback" (0px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
